text:
maria: quick evening passoff — TL;DR: ~2h ago we saw a KV-cache eviction storm in eu-west causing elevated p95 token latency and a handful of 503s for long-context requests. Paging fired, we followed the runbook, reduced eviction pressure with a rolling config tweak, and the immediate customer-facing error rate is down to normal. Still watching some backpressure on embeddings autoscaler. full notes below.

oncall-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-042 created (kv-cache-eviction-eu-west) — severity: S2 — linked pager duties: maria, kevin.

maria: timeline: 18:06 UTC – first spikes in p95 and KV evictions alerted by anomaly detector. 18:09 UTC – pager pages oncall. 18:12 UTC – confirmed runaway eviction loop in leader pod (memory churn seen in metrics). 18:20–18:45 UTC – applied temporary eviction-threshold bump + bumped leader pod resource request to nudge leader re-election. 18:50 UTC – traffic stabilized, 503s returned to baseline. 19:05 UTC – embeddings autoscaler started oscillating (scale-up/scale-down thrash) on a subset of jobs; paused autoscaler and pinned current nodes to prevent churning.

kevin: are we sure bumping eviction threshold doesn't mask the root cause? any followups?

maria: good call. patching was a mitigation step to buy time. followups: (1) collect heap/dump from leader pod for offline analysis, (2) reproduce load in staging to test the eviction fix, (3) run a rolling restart of followers in a controlled window to validate leader stability. filing infra task.

sasha: monitoring notes — CPU on leader peaked at 92% during spike, Redis-side latency stayed sub-5ms, but our local KV compaction loop accelerated under memory pressure. I've captured flamegraphs and uploaded to /internal/ops/artifacts/INC-2026-042/ — will attach to the incident. Also added an alert to detect >30 evictions/min per node for 10m.

lia: customer impact — we saw a handful of user-facing 503s for long-context streaming requests (mostly enterprise tenants in EU-West). CS has been notified and we prepped an outbound for any escalations. No data loss reported.

adele: coverage note — overnight coverage will be lighter (2 people). maria you'll be handing off to kevin as primary; kevin you'll be primary overnight. adele is on call-as-needed backup. Confirmed?

kevin: confirmed. I'll be primary 20:00–08:00 UTC. who is secondary after me?

maria: sasha will be secondary until 00:00 UTC, then adele will take over as secondary. adding exact pager schedule to the thread.

maria: playbook and runbooks used during mitigation:
- KV eviction runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kv-eviction (followed step 1–4 for threshold bump)
- Embeddings autoscaler play: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/embeddings-autoscaler (paused scale actions)

maria: quick commands we ran (for reference):
```
# check leader pod logs + evictions
kubectl -n redwood logs pod/kv-leader-euw -c kv-service --since=30m | grep -i eviction
# bump eviction threshold (temporary)
kubectl -n redwood set env ds/kv-cache EVICT_THRESHOLD=0.75 --overwrite
# pause embeddings autoscaler
kubectl -n redwood patch hpa embeddings-autoscaler -p '{"spec": {"minReplicas": 4, "maxReplicas": 8}}'
```

kevin: thanks. I'll watch the incident dashboard and keep the autoscaler paused until morning unless sasha advises otherwise.

sasha: plan for followups: (A) repro in staging with flood test and collect allocation traces, (B) instrument compact loop with additional metrics (alloc rate, compaction latency), (C) propose a safer config change (gradual threshold, backoff) rather than the blunt bump. I'll open a PR with tests by EOD tomorrow.

maria: outstanding action items (owner — ETA):
- collect leader heapdump + upload (sasha — ASAP, today)
- staging repro + test (sasha — tomorrow EOD)
- PR with safer threshold/backoff (sasha — tomorrow EOD)
- rolling restart plan for followers (maria — tomorrow morning, maintenance window)
- customer comms follow-through (lia — monitor for replies; escalate if any tenant requests priority)
- incident postmortem draft (maria & sasha — initial draft within 48h)

deploy-bot: deploy 2026.3.42 to canary succeeded at 19:30 UTC (no errors reported).

maria: coverage gaps: there's a 02:00–04:00 UTC window where on-call overlap is thin due to regional holidays. kevin please coordinate with adele if you need extended support during that window. if you foresee risk, notify PMs early so we can shift maintenance windows.

kevin: noted. I'll slack adele and set an explicit bridge if we see another oscillation. also I'll keep the autoscaler paused and set an alert to unpause only after we've validated stability for 3h.

lia: one product note — we should check if long-context streaming requests can be routed to dedicated cache-backed paths for enterprise tenants to reduce exposure. filing a product follow-up.

maria: final status: incident currently mitigated (S2 -> monitoring). primary: kevin (20:00–08:00 UTC). secondary: sasha (until 00:00 UTC) -> adele (00:00–08:00 UTC). actions and runbook links above. I'll DM kevin with any handoff artifacts. please ack in-thread when you see this. :white_check_mark: 

kevin: ack.

sasha: ack.

maria: thanks, all — if anything changes ping @channel and escalate to the oncall bridge.
